test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**have three**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The subject of the sentence is plural, so we need to use "have" instead of "has."**
 
• **The sentence is in present tense, so "had" will also be eliminated.**
 
• Thus, "Has three" (Option 1) and "had three" (Option 4) are both incorrect verb tenses for the sentence. 
 
• "Only three" (Option 2) is not grammatically correct, as it changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct phrase to use is "have three" as the subject is plural.
 
• The number "three" in the phrase indicates the body parts of the butterflies.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
